description: Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten Bahnhof is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Die Infrastrukturdatenbank oder POI-Datenbank der Stadt Gelsenkirchen bietet Ihnen umfangreiche Informationen über Infrastrukturen in Gelsenkirchen. Sie haben derzeit die Möglichkeit, auf über 100 verschiedene Infrastrukturarten sowie über 7000 Datensätzen aus den Themenbereichen Familie, Bildung, Freizeit, Infrastruktur, Kultur, Verwaltung, Soziales und Wirtschaft zuzugreifen. Neben der räumlichen Lage sind Informationen zu Kontaktdaten und weiteren Fachinformationen hinterlegt. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are bahn, datensatz, eisenbahn, lokal, opendata. It offers 4 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
